title: HB 252 (108th General Assembly): As introduced, allows any photo identification issued by public institution of higher learning to be used as evidence of identification for voting purposes. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(2), Section 1
(quote) A valid identification card issued by a branch, department, agency, or entity of this state, any other state, or the United States authorized by law to issue personal identification including any public institution of higher education; provided, that such identification card contains a photograph of the voter;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft (only version saved): rewrites (c)(2) so photo IDs from other states and from public colleges or universities count (slot a).
(other) note: Never left House Local Government Subcommittee (taken off notice 2013-04-02). No votes recorded. Same text as SB1082.
